drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview model card CBRN section and footnote 4; successor VCT arXiv:2504.16137 for provenance only. VMQA4 is the name printed in the Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview card for SecureBio's single-choice early Virology Capabilities Test. The card describes it as a biological knowledge-and-reasoning MCQ evaluation and explicitly notes that VMQA refers to an earlier VCT version. It does not disclose item construction, scale, or split. Evaluation presents the external items, parses one choice, computes exact accuracy, and compares Gemini generations. The published successor VCT contains 322 expert-authored multimodal multiple-response questions, but those later details are provenance context and cannot be copied into VMQA4 as if they described the same release.
